neighbours.label: the function name in a Python 'def' line when that function was already called earlier in the same file (definition of a name used above)

notes: Card: every top example is the name piece right after 'def' / 'def _', and in the two examples with enough context the name was called a few lines above. Probes: 'def save' after an earlier 'save(...)' call 0.92, 'def _set_workspace_units' after an earlier call 0.46; plain def lines with no earlier use 0.02-0.05. Near misses are the same kind of file with the definitions first, so no def repeats an earlier name. The + pole also sits on def names ('get', '_info').
